title: MintX Solutions Company Overview & Salem Location
content: MintX Solutions is a premier technology, custom software, and digital services company headquartered in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. MintX Solutions provides cutting-edge digital transformation services including responsive website development, e-commerce development, custom web and mobile applications, digital marketing (SEO & SMM), payment gateway integration, and smart QR business solutions. The company is situated in Salem, Tamil Nadu, serving local businesses in Salem, Coimbatore, Erode, Chennai, as well as global clients.

title: MintX Solutions Contact Information and Human Support
content: MintX Solutions contact details: Office Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu. Official Phone: 04446310677. Support Email: support@mintxsolutions.com / contact@mintxsolutions.com. Working Hours: Monday to Saturday from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST. If a customer asks to speak with a human executive or team member, Yazhini can connect them to the MintX team directly at 04446310677 or note their phone number for an immediate callback.

title: Website Development Services
content: MintX Solutions builds modern, fast, mobile-responsive business websites, landing pages, corporate portals, and personal portfolios. We use modern technologies like React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, TailwindCSS, and WordPress/headless CMS. All websites include free SSL, SEO-friendly architecture, fast loading speed, domain & hosting setup assistance, and 30 days of free post-launch support. Pricing depends on features and pages: starter business websites typically start around ₹8,000 to ₹15,000, while custom dynamic websites depend on specific requirements.

title: E-Commerce Website & Online Store Development
content: MintX Solutions specializes in full-featured e-commerce websites and online stores for retail, fashion, groceries, electronics, and D2C brands. Features include: product catalog, shopping cart, customer accounts, payment gateway integration (Razorpay, UPI, PhonePe, Google Pay, Credit/Debit cards, Cash on Delivery), order tracking, automated SMS/WhatsApp alerts, coupon codes, and admin dashboard. E-commerce packages typically range from ₹20,000 to ₹45,000 depending on product catalog size and custom features.

title: Mobile App Development (Android & iOS)
content: MintX Solutions develops high-performance native and cross-platform mobile apps for Android and iOS using Flutter and React Native. Services include custom business apps, customer booking apps, delivery apps, e-commerce mobile apps, and enterprise management tools. Apps feature push notifications, real-time tracking, offline sync, secure authentication, and Google Play Store / Apple App Store deployment. Quotations are customized based on user flow and technical scope.

title: Custom Software, ERP & Billing Systems
content: MintX Solutions develops tailored software applications for businesses: Billing & POS systems, Inventory Management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), School & Hospital Management systems, and Workflow Automation. Built with robust backends (Python FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) with role-based access control, analytics, and automated reporting.

title: Digital Marketing, SEO & Social Media
content: MintX Solutions offers complete digital marketing services to help businesses grow online: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) for top Google rankings, Local SEO for Salem and regional Google Maps ranking, Social Media Marketing (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn), Meta Ads, Google Ads (PPC), lead generation campaigns, and content creation.

title: MintX QR Smart Business Solutions
content: MintX QR is a proprietary smart QR product offering: digital restaurant menus with contactless ordering, Google Review tap/scan cards, dynamic digital business cards (vCard QR), payment QR displays, and asset tracking QR codes. Easy to update menus and details in real-time without reprinting.

title: 3D Printing & Rapid Prototyping Solutions
content: MintX Solutions provides industrial and custom 3D printing services in Salem: rapid prototyping, architectural models, custom product enclosures, mechanical spare parts, and custom personalized gifts. Supports high-detail PLA, ABS, PETG, and Resin printing with quick turnaround times.

title: MintX Solutions Pricing & Quotation Policy
content: At MintX Solutions, pricing is transparent and requirement-based. Standard business websites start from approximately ₹8,000 to ₹15,000. E-commerce online stores typically range from ₹20,000 to ₹45,000. Mobile apps and custom software depend on features, platforms, and integrations. Agent rule: Never invent or guarantee a final price without requirement confirmation; inform the client that price varies with features and offer to connect them with the technical team for an exact quotation.

title: Project Timelines & Delivery Schedules
content: Standard business websites are delivered within 7 to 14 business days. E-commerce websites take approximately 2 to 4 weeks depending on product catalog and integrations. Custom mobile apps and complex software take 4 to 8 weeks with milestone demos. Emergency / fast-track delivery is available upon request.

title: Support, AMC and Maintenance
content: Every project delivered by MintX Solutions includes 30 days of complimentary technical support and bug fixes. Post-warranty, MintX offers affordable Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) covering server monitoring, regular backups, security patches, content updates, and priority technical assistance.
